newCandidatesThisWeek.rationale: 1.5-second cut cadence is now a documented benchmark for YouTube Shorts — this is a distinct pacing-enforcement tool not covered by existing pattern-break or pacing tools
Hybrid Shorts-to-long-form funnel requires a clip-extraction and timestamp-link operation that maps Shorts back to source long-form footage — new editing capability not in existing set
First-frame bold text overlay combined with trending audio is a distinct compound action (text + audio sync on frame 0) that differs from existing edit_text_overlay_hook (which applies mid-video)
Compressed storytelling front-load pattern (opening text card → video proof → punchline) is a structural format requiring text-card generation and sequencing not covered by existing tools
Three-panel horizontal split (wore/went/did) is a distinct layout requiring horizontal split-screen with three equal panels — different from existing vertical split-screen tools
Yellow Font Theory demands a specific styling (yellow, high-contrast, emotionally-coded font) applied as caption overlay — a distinct caption styling action not in the existing toolset
Unusual POV angle crop/reframe (barrel-mount, tree-stand, boots-eye) for scroll-stop effect is a new angle-selection and crop operation for unconventional camera positions

summary: 7 new bridge tool candidates identified this week. Highest priority: edit_rapid_cut_pacing (YouTube 1.5s cut benchmark), edit_first_frame_text_hook (YouTube frame-0 compound hook), edit_text_situation_setup (TikTok front-load storytelling structure), edit_three_panel_horizontal_split (Instagram 3-panel layout — distinct from prior vertical split tools). No existing tools deprecated. Fall hunting season content wave signals a high-volume posting period for outdoor creators across all platforms through November.
